recognize_zh: 成片中到大型淋巴細胞，核圓到稍不規則、染色質細緻分散呈母細胞樣、核仁小，胞質稀少，並可見凋亡細胞；這種像淋巴母細胞的形態是 blastoid 型套細胞淋巴瘤，需 cyclin D1/SOX11 確認並與淋巴母細胞淋巴瘤區分。
features: Diffuse sheets of medium-to-large lymphoid cells
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with finely dispersed blastic chromatin
Scattered apoptotic bodies and dark crushed nuclei
Occasional pink hyalinized small vessels; no starry-sky pattern
describe_en: Lymph node section shows diffuse sheets of monotonous medium-to-large lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei, finely dispersed blast-like chromatin, small nucleoli and scant cytoplasm. Scattered apoptotic bodies are present, but a starry-sky pattern is not evident. Occasional hyalinized small vessels are seen. The morphology resembles lymphoblasts; in combination with CD5+ and cyclin D1+ or SOX11+ B-cell phenotype, findings are consistent with the blastoid variant of mantle cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblastic lymphoma is TdT-positive and cyclin D1-negative despite identical blastic chromatin.
Burkitt lymphoma shows a starry-sky pattern with squared-off cells, CD10+/BCL2-, Ki-67 near 100% and MYC rearrangement.
DLBCL cells are larger with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli and lack cyclin D1/SOX11.
Myeloid sarcoma is MPO/CD33/CD117-positive and CD20/PAX5-negative, often with eosinophilic myelocytes.
